source.publication: FAQ: list of retirement system benefits that may be excluded from Louisiana income tax
source.section: FAQ page 1, Federal Retirement Benefits Exclusion (R.S. 47:44.2); instructions PDF page 7 code 04E (does not name railroad benefits); Schedule E Lines 1, 3, 4A to 4H, 5 (Form IT-540 PDF page 8; instructions PDF pages 6, 7 and 10); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 40,000.00 + Railroad Retirement benefits (person 0) 30,000.00 = 70,000.00. Federal taxable income = 70,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 54,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. Schedule E: Line 1 federal AGI 70,000.00. Line 3 total = 70,000.00. Exempt income: code 04E Railroad Retirement benefits 30,000.00. Line 4H = 30,000.00. Line 5 Louisiana AGI = 70,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 40,000.00. IT-540 Line 7 (from Schedule E Line 5) 40,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 40,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 27,500.00. Line 11 = 27,500.00 x .03 = 825.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 825.00. The only source is the FAQ page, under the Federal Retirement Benefits Exclusion; the amount is the federal taxable amount.
accepted_approximations: All Railroad Retirement income is treated as exempt. The only source says benefits 'received by federal retirees' may be excluded, and does not say who else qualifies.
